allow: PowerShell($c = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 4000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; foreach \($x in $c\) { Stop-Process -Id $x.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; "4000 cleared")
